# Pluto Travels

> Pluto Travels LLC is an IATA-accredited travel agency based in Business Bay, Dubai, UAE, operating since 2007. We provide corporate travel management, MICE (meetings, incentives, conferences & exhibitions) planning, luxury travel concierge services, outbound visa assistance, and curated holiday packages for businesses and individuals, primarily serving UAE residents and companies travelling internationally.

Key facts:
- Legal name: Pluto Travels LLC
- Founded: 2007
- Headquarters: Office 2805, Prism Tower, Business Bay, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Accreditations: IATA, ISO 9001, ICV
- Core services: corporate travel management, MICE & group events, luxury travel concierge, outbound visa assistance, holiday packages
- Sector specialists: energy & oil/gas, marine crew, mining, sports team travel
- Contact: +971 4 392 0930 (office), +971 50 911 0065 (mobile/WhatsApp), sales@plutotravels.ae

- [Luxury Travel](https://www.plutotravels.ae/luxury-travel): Bespoke luxury holidays and concierge service.
- [Platinum Concierge](https://www.plutotravels.ae/platinum): VIP travel concierge for HNI clients.
- [Visa Services](https://www.plutotravels.ae/visa/africa): Outbound visa assistance for Africa, the Middle East, Europe, Asia, Canada, the USA and the CIS.
- [Holiday Packages](https://www.plutotravels.ae/holidays): Curated leisure holiday packages from Dubai.
- [Specialized Industry Travel](https://www.plutotravels.ae/industries): Energy, marine crew, mining and sports team travel.
- [Contact](https://www.plutotravels.ae/contact): Request a quote or speak with the Dubai team.
